name: Instagram ReVanced Patches - bluecxt
description: Dedicated ReVanced patches for Instagram v442/v443

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Complete ad-blocker eliminating sponsored items from the Main Feed, Reels, and Stories without crashes.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds a Download option to the post and Reels menu to save photos and videos.

patches.name: Disable swipe navigation
patches.description: Disables swiping between the main navigation tabs and swiping to the camera.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Disables analytics that are sent periodically.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches.name: Change link sharing domain
patches.description: Replaces the domain name of shared links.

patches.name: Enable developer menu
patches.description: Enables the internal developer options in settings.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Changes links to always open in your external browser, instead of the in-app browser.

patches.name: Hide explore feed
patches.description: Hides posts and reels from the explore/search page.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Hides navigation bar buttons, such as the Reels and Create button.

patches.name: Hide suggested content
patches.description: Hides suggested stories, reels, threads and survey from feed.

patches.name: Hide highlights tray
patches.description: Hides the highlights tray in profile section.

patches.name: Hide Stories from Home
patches.description: Hides Stories from the main page, by removing the buttons.

patches.name: Limit feed to followed profiles
patches.description: Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.

patches.name: Disable Reels scrolling
patches.description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels.

patches.name: Disable Reels auto-scroll
patches.description: Removes the auto-scroll toggle and prevents Reels from scrolling automatically.

patches.name: Disable story auto flipping
patches.description: Disable stories automatically flipping/skipping after some seconds.

patches.name: Enable location sticker redesign
patches.description: Unlocks the redesigned location sticker with additional style options.

patches.name: Anonymous story viewing
patches.description: View stories without sending any information to the server.

patches.name: Disable signature check
patches.description: Disables the signature check that can cause the app to crash on startup.
